name: comp-170
title: Billing Period Toggle
blurb: Sliding toggle between monthly and yearly billing with discount badge.
description: Billing period selector with animated sliding background indicator. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup with state management.
use_when: Toggling between annual and monthly pricing plans with a clear visual affordance for the discount.
avoid_when: More than 2 options or when animation may distract from the choice.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with keyboard support and focus-visible indicator on the animated background.
